OwnTape — popup states

Visual spec. Width 340 px. Each state shows the light and the dark theme. Copy markup from popup.html, styles from popup.css.

  • 1 · Not on a Meet tab
  • 2 · Ready (chat notice on)
  • 2c · Ready, chat notice off (long reminder comes back)
  • 3 · Starting
  • 4 · Recording, notice posted
  • 4a · Recording, notice being posted
  • 4c · Recording, notice NOT posted (warning, recording continues)
  • 4b · Recording, microphone off, chat notice off
  • 4d · Recording, microphone failed (warning, recording continues)
  • 4e · Recording, microphone refused AND notice not posted (hint text hides)
  • 9 · Settings view (from the gear or “Change”)
  • 9b · Settings view, only 2 quality options, High selected
  • 5 · Saving, percentage not known yet (moving bar)
  • 5b · Saving, 45 %
  • 6 · Saved
  • 7a · Error: microphone blocked
  • 7b · Error: Meet tab closed during recording
  • 7c · Error: cannot capture the tab (with technical detail)
  • 7d · Microphone not allowed yet (first use)
  • 7e · Recording stopped unexpectedly + recovery card
  • 7f · Error: something went wrong (generic)
  • 8 · Ready + recovery card (target card hides to save space)
  • 8b · Not on a Meet tab + 2 unsaved recordings, “Delete” waits for a 2nd click
